summary: Added runtime_contracts::ecosystem as the shared, dependency-free ecosystem contract boundary for AgentOS artifacts.
acceptance_evidence: runtime_contracts now exposes ecosystem schemas without importing agent_core, security_execution or agentd.
The module defines deterministic to_json and stable_contract_hash helpers for shared schema fingerprints.
Manifest, registry, lockfile, verification, staging, activation, active set, compatibility and trust policy contract types are present.
Side-effect behavior is represented as reports and validation state only; no execution crate or runtime mutation logic is introduced.

commands.summary: agent_core 94, agentd 56, runtime_contracts 20 and security_execution 75 tests passed.

blocked_shortcuts: runtime_contracts does not import execution crates.
No artifact contract can activate by staging alone.
No normal-mode shell semantic tool is introduced.
optional_dependencies: No external network, remote LLM, Firecracker binary or host package manager dependency is required.
promotion_impact: Creates the stable contract surface required before local registry, staging and runtime-mediated activation work.
